bio.text: Howard M. Beaty Jr. represents District 95 in the Arkansas House of Representatives, which includes Ashley and Chicot counties, is serving his third term, and serves as House Majority Leader.
The House says Beaty has more than 30 years of experience in banking and economic development and has served as president of two Arkansas state-chartered banks.
He has a bachelor's degree in accounting from Louisiana Tech University and is active in Crossett, Arkansas, including the Rotary Club and the Ashley County Republican Committee.
